title: My PC: live Windows desktop over trusted Wi-Fi
summary: Added a Windows desktop viewer with pairing, touch, keyboard and disconnect controls, plus a local start/stop helper. Validation and APK delivery are pending.

changes.detail: Separate My PC screen with private Wi-Fi address validation, restricted WebView and disconnect on background; trilingual Android instructions.

Local paired browser-to-VNC bridge, origin and host checks, rate-limited pairing, one session, expiry, stop command and portable loopback-only Windows server. No service, startup registration or public deployment.
Prepared Android 1.0.7 build 9; ignored local helper binaries and secrets.

validation.name: Application and device validation
validation.detail: Tests, native build, Windows runtime connection and phone acceptance are pending. No updated APK installed or published.
